summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a board-approved reverse stock split at a 1-for-3 ratio, effective July 6, 2026. The split reduces outstanding Class A ordinary shares from ~10.26M to ~3.42M; fractional shares are rounded up to one full share. No shareholder vote was required under BVI law, and no par value change or authorized share reduction occurs. The ticker remains NIVF with a new CUSIP. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation, driven by Nasdaq listing compliance. No deal terms apply; watch for potential delisting risk if price remains below threshold.
